status: development informed by v8 and all earlier inspected outcomes; no independent confirmation
algorithm: Fuse train-normalized monotone T and uHNDI anchors with weight w. Robustly squash four evidence distribution/persistence descriptors, regress them on both anchors using training patients only, and learn a bounded pairwise logistic ranking correction with L2 penalty. At eta=0 return the fused anchor. The same feature definitions, optimizer and search grid apply to all cohorts.
positive_fraction: Fraction of existing v8 positive-evidence observations, pooled across original streams; no labels involved.
target_gini: Gini coefficient of nonnegative target observations, zero when all target values are zero. Sorting is used only for this distribution descriptor; adjacency always uses original chronological order.
mean_local_contrast: Mean original contrast applied to each local target observation with original patient-level R and F retained. This tests nonlinear pooling and does not claim access to local antagonist measurements.
excess_positive_adjacency: Phi correlation of binary positive evidence at consecutive valid links, using separate left/right marginals; zero for absent links or zero marginal variance. No edges across records, channels, rejected epochs, or time gaps. Unlike v8, this corrects for marginal prevalence and does not normalize run length by total recording duration.
anchors: Each anchor is independently transformed using training median/IQR with std/1 fallback, then asinh. Residualization basis=[1, normalized T, normalized original uHNDI], training-only least squares. No held-out cohort/patient scaling or label information used for extraction.
shuffle_control: One fixed within-contiguous-segment permutation per subject, preserving target/positive pairs and all distributions. Only excess adjacency changes. This is a sensitivity control, not a permutation p-value.
classical_inputs: Exactly T, original uHNDI and the same four descriptors; LR C=[.1,1,10], shrinkage-LDA auto, RF max_depth=[2,3,null], n_estimators=200,min_samples_leaf=3,max_features=sqrt; every fit and choice training-only.
selection: Mean inner-fold AUC. Differences within 1e-12 tie to earliest candidate: anchor-only first, then smaller correction and stronger regularization. Same grid for primary and two feature ablations; controls explicitly retain different capacities. No reliability screening on outer outcomes.
metric: Mean outer-fold AUC, five seeds, equal-weight three-cohort macro. All cohort outcomes and same-input comparisons retained.
performance_target: Positive macro delta over T and original uHNDI at every seed; positive five-seed mean delta over both in each cohort; positive macro mean delta over anchor_fusion. Persistence-specific innovation additionally requires positive mean macro delta over distribution_only_rank and shuffled_evidence_rank, reported separately.
boundaries: AUC improvement is empirical, never guaranteed. Target measurements and positive masks inherit v8 adapters and their aggregate/window limitations. Binary Wielek target distribution descriptors may be functions of occupancy; residualization does not prove independence. Gains due to choosing a stronger baseline must be separated using anchor_fusion. Repeated development on these same subjects needs future independent confirmation. All earlier outputs and source fingerprints remain protected.
